items.title: Labor icon Dolores Huerta dies at 96
items.feedTitle: Dolores Huerta, labor and civil rights icon, dies at 96
items.summary: Dolores Huerta, co-founder of the United Farm Workers union and civil rights champion, died at age 96. She was instrumental in improving working conditions in fruit and vegetable fields and coined the phrase "Sí, se puede!" which became a widespread rallying cry for social movements. Her decades-long activism left a lasting impact on labor rights and civil rights in the United States.

items.title: Democrats emphasize economy in final campaign week
items.feedTitle: Democrats put economy and affordability at center of final campaign push
items.summary: With one week until Election Day, Democrats are centering their final campaign push on the economy and affordability as voters express concern about everyday costs. President Trump is campaigning in traditionally Republican Texas, where Democrats see opportunities for gains. Economic messaging appears central to both parties' closing strategies.

items.title: Democrats hold eight-point lead in final election poll
items.feedTitle: Poll gauges voter enthusiasm for both parties a week before election
items.summary: A new PBS News/NPR/Marist poll shows Democrats with an eight-point advantage among likely voters, extending to 13 points among independents, one week before Election Day. The survey reflects voter enthusiasm and preference one week out from the midterms.

items.title: ICE partnerships with local police double in eight months
items.feedTitle: Partnerships between ICE and local police surge, report finds
items.summary: The number of state and local officers working with Immigration and Customs Enforcement has doubled in size over the last eight months, according to a report from immigration reform advocacy group FWD.us. The expansion of partnerships between local law enforcement and ICE marks a significant increase in immigration enforcement coordination at the state and local level.

stlouis.title: Missouri AG investigates St. Louis police chief's raise
stlouis.feedTitle: Missouri AG taps politically connected firm to investigate St. Louis police chief's raise
stlouis.summary: Missouri's Attorney General has engaged a politically connected Kansas City-based firm to investigate the St. Louis police board's decision regarding Chief Tracy's compensation. The inquiry addresses questions raised about the raise and governance at the police department.

stlouis.title: Jamestown Mall site planned for 700-home transformation
stlouis.feedTitle: Jamestown Mall site set for major transformation, 700 homes planned
stlouis.summary: The Jamestown Mall site is set for major redevelopment, with plans to build approximately 700 new homes. This represents significant development activity in the St. Louis metro area's real estate market.

stlouis.title: MetroLink Blue Line to run limited schedule next two months
stlouis.feedTitle: Limited runs planned for MetroLink Blue Line trains the next two months
stlouis.summary: MetroLink has announced that Blue Line trains will operate on a limited schedule over the next two months. The service reduction is temporary and will affect commuters during this period.

items.title: Spain train collision kills at least 64 people
items.feedTitle: At least 64 reported dead in high-speed train collision in Spain, authorities say
items.summary: Two high-speed trains collided near Toledo, Spain, resulting in at least 64 deaths and dozens injured. More than 500 passengers were on board the trains when the incident occurred, marking the country's second major rail disaster in a year and raising questions about safety standards in Spain's extensive rail network.

items.title: Israel election results show no clear winner
items.feedTitle: Israel election: what we know so far
items.summary: With nearly all votes counted from Israel's election, neither Prime Minister Netanyahu's coalition nor the main opposition parties have secured a majority, potentially forcing weeks of coalition negotiations. The election saw record voter turnout, and Palestinian parties made significant gains, complicating political math for any potential government formation.

items.title: Russell Brand denies rape allegations, claims consensual acts
items.feedTitle: Russell Brand tells trial he had sex obsession but that consent is ‘non-negotiable’
items.summary: Actor and former comedian Russell Brand, 51, testified in court on rape and sexual assault charges, admitting to having an obsession with sex as a younger man but denying he set himself a goal to sleep with 5,000 women. He maintains all sexual encounters were consensual despite facing multiple charges including rape.

items.title: Ethiopia receives 12 Russian Su-35 fighter jets
items.feedTitle: Ethiopia receives 12 Russian Su-35 jets, plans S-400 acquisition
items.summary: Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed announced the receipt of 12 Russian Su-35 aircraft during a Moscow summit, with plans to acquire S-400 air defense systems to follow. The acquisition comes as Ethiopia battles armed groups in the Tigray and Amhara regions.

items.title: Egypt fines editor, shuts independent news outlet Mada Masr
items.feedTitle: Egypt fines prominent editor Lina Attalah and shuts independent news outlet Mada Masr
items.summary: Egyptian authorities have fined prominent journalist Lina Attalah and ordered the closure of the independent news outlet Mada Masr after she was convicted of managing an unlicensed website. The action is part of escalating concerns over press freedom restrictions in Cairo.

items.title: Cyclone Arnab batters north Andhra with deadly impact
items.feedTitle: 5 dead as Cyclone Arnab batters north Andhra with heavy rain
items.summary: Cyclone Arnab has brought extremely heavy rain and winds gusting up to 150 kmph to coastal districts in northern Andhra Pradesh, killing at least 5 people. Over 1,000 trees have been uprooted and crops across 80,500 hectares have been damaged by the severe weather system.

items.title: Sharp cuts in cancer drug prices take effect in November
items.feedTitle: Sharp cuts in price of cancer drugs expose excessive pricing, say health experts
items.summary: The National Pharmaceutical Pricing Authority has released revised maximum retail prices for 543 brands of anti-cancer medicines, with the new prices effective from November 9. Health experts say the price cuts expose excessive pricing, though controlling trade margins alone may not be sufficient to ensure affordability based on medical need.

items.title: Jio Platforms breaks India's IPO record on debut
items.feedTitle: Jio Platforms breaks India's IPO record
items.summary: Jio Platforms made its stock market debut at a 21% premium, with valuation topping ₹12 lakh crore, breaking India's IPO record. The listing represents a major milestone for the telecom and digital services conglomerate.

items.title: Delhi SIR exercise draws INDIA bloc allegations of voter exclusion
items.feedTitle: Delhi SIR: INDIA bloc demands exercise rollback, alleges large-scale voter exclusion without verification
items.summary: The INDIA bloc has demanded a rollback of Delhi's Special Summary Revision (SIR) exercise, alleging large-scale voter exclusion without proper verification. The opposition coalition claims the electoral process lacks due process and disenfranchises eligible voters.

items.title: Nirmala Sitharaman, Rahul Gandhi clash over Tata leadership dispute
items.feedTitle: Nirmala Sitharaman, Rahul Gandhi spar over Tata Group leadership dispute
items.summary: Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman and Congress leader Rahul Gandhi have sparred over the Tata Group's internal leadership battle. Gandhi has questioned India Inc.'s silence on what he calls the conglomerate's "criminal destruction," while Sitharaman dismissed his concerns as seeing "ghosts everywhere."

immigration.title: DHS ends automatic EAD extensions, proposed rule finalized
immigration.feedTitle: Removal of Automatic Extensions for Certain Employment Authorization Documents
immigration.summary: On October 30, 2025, DHS published an interim final rule ending the practice of automatically extending employment authorization documents (Forms I-766 or EADs) for aliens who have timely filed renewal applications. This finalized and in-effect policy removes protections that previously allowed work authorization to continue pending adjudication, now requiring reapplication or separate extension requests.

immigration.title: US moves closer to PERM green card sponsorship overhaul
immigration.feedTitle: US moves closer to PERM overhaul amid crackdown on green card sponsorship
immigration.summary: The United States is moving toward overhauling the PERM labor certification process for green card sponsorship amid a broader crackdown on employment-based immigration. The proposed changes represent a shift in how employers sponsor foreign workers for permanent residency and reflect tightening visa policies.

immigration.title: Trump administration restricts H-1B extension work permits
immigration.feedTitle: Trump Administration Moves to End H-1B Extension Protections, Finalizes Restrictions on Work Permit Renewals
immigration.summary: The Trump administration has finalized restrictions on H-1B work permit renewals and moved to end H-1B extension protections for visa-dependent employers. The proposed and finalized rules represent significant changes to visa-dependent employment authorization, increasing hiring costs and uncertainty for employers relying on H-1B workers.

items.title: Jio Platforms debuts at 21% premium amid market decline
items.feedTitle: Jio Platforms debuts at 21% premium as Sensex slides; valuation tops ₹12 lakh crore
items.summary: Jio Platforms made its highly anticipated stock market debut, listing at a 21% premium to the issue price with a valuation exceeding ₹12 lakh crore, breaking India's IPO record. However, the Sensex declined 353 points on the day, with Reliance, IT stocks, and rising crude oil prices weighing on the broader market.

items.title: GE Vernova acquires Trench for $9 billion grid expansion
items.feedTitle: GE Vernova boosts grid push with $9 billion Trench deal, lifts revenue forecast
items.summary: GE Vernova has agreed to purchase German grid-equipment manufacturer Trench for approximately $9 billion and has raised its revenue forecast as artificial intelligence and data center demand drives electric power consumption higher. The acquisition positions GE Vernova to capitalize on surging demand for grid infrastructure.

items.title: Bank of Canada raises key rate for first time in three years
items.feedTitle: Bank of Canada raises key interest rate, says another hike possible
items.summary: The Bank of Canada increased its key interest rate by a quarter point for the first time in three years as soaring energy prices pushed up inflation. The central bank's move reflects efforts to combat rising price pressures amid global economic headwinds.

items.title: Nelson Peltz group offers $1.4 billion for struggling Wendy's
items.feedTitle: Nelson Peltz-led group offers to buy Wendy’s for $1.4B
items.summary: A group led by billionaire investor Nelson Peltz has made a $1.4 billion offer to take the fast-food chain Wendy's private. The offer comes as the burger chain struggles with rising beef prices and challenges in the competitive quick-service restaurant market.

items.title: Eli Lilly's retatrutide doubles weight loss versus Ozempic
items.feedTitle: Bye bye Ozempic: Eli Lilly says its new drug retatrutide more than doubles weight loss
items.summary: Eli Lilly announced that its new drug retatrutide provides more than double the weight loss of Ozempic in clinical trials, representing a major development in the competitive weight-loss pharmaceutical market. The announcement underscores the intense competition among drugmakers developing next-generation weight-loss treatments.

cards.title: Credibility through constraint
cards.insight: Anthropic and other AI leaders are voluntarily signaling risks and limitations (uninsurable catastrophes, court oversight) rather than overselling capabilities. This transparent framing builds trust with regulators and enterprise customers who've been burned by overhyped tech before.
cards.takeaway: When pitching a new initiative or product, lead with what you *can't* or *won't* do—it reframes uncertainty as thoughtfulness, not evasion.

cards.title: Reframing through scale
cards.insight: Bank of Canada and Fed communication pivot to energy inflation rather than wage pressures when explaining rate moves; this shifts blame from their models to external shocks, making their inaction feel deliberate rather than reactive.
cards.takeaway: When defending a decision critics dislike, expand the frame to a larger systemic force—it makes the constraint feel situational, not ideological.

cards.title: Asymmetric narrative control
cards.insight: Democrats in US politics emphasize economy and affordability one week out; Republicans counter with election integrity claims. Both sides are narrating the *stakes*, not the *facts*, to mobilize bases.
cards.takeaway: In competitive environments, whoever defines what voters (or buyers) should worry about wins—invest in framing the problem before offering solutions.

cards.title: Silence as strategy
cards.insight: Nirmala Sitharaman dismisses Rahul Gandhi's Tata Group concerns with mockery ('ghosts everywhere') rather than engaging substance. This works when you hold institutional power and doubt can compound faster than rebuttal.
cards.takeaway: If a criticism lacks mainstream traction, mockery + institutional backing can be more effective than detailed defense—but only if your base already trusts you.

ai.title: Anthropic seeks court authority to block risky AI models
ai.feedTitle: Anthropic tells California governor courts should be able to block risky AI models
ai.summary: Anthropic has told California's governor that courts should be able to block risky AI models as the company navigates regulatory scrutiny ahead of its IPO. The position reflects ongoing debate over AI governance and the appropriate role of the judiciary in evaluating AI safety.

ai.title: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 adds audio and live steering
ai.feedTitle: Google DeepMind’s Genie 4 world model adds sound and live steering
ai.summary: Google DeepMind has released Genie 4, an updated world model that adds sound, more realistic physics, and real-time steering capabilities while maintaining consistent scenes for up to two minutes—double its predecessor's duration. The advancement represents progress in AI systems capable of generating and controlling interactive virtual environments.

ai.title: NVIDIA releases open-weight speech transcription model
ai.feedTitle: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
ai.summary: NVIDIA has released a free, open-weight speech-to-text model capable of transcribing up to 40 languages and operating on a dataset of 463,062 hours of audio. While it only processes recorded audio rather than live streams, the model represents a significant step forward for meeting and medical transcription applications.

ai.title: Google recruits cloud partners to sell more AI chips
ai.feedTitle: Google alters its cloud playbook, enlisting partners to sell more AI chips
ai.summary: Google is altering its cloud sales strategy by enlisting partners to help distribute its AI chips, including TPUs and new custom processors. The shift reflects Google's effort to expand AI hardware market share amid intense competition from NVIDIA and OpenAI's growing computing demands.
